Geth Removes Holesky Testnet｜Decommissioning Doesn’t Mean the Ethereum Mainnet Is Shutting Down｜Around 2683 USDT, I’ll wait for confirmation first

My stance is very clear: I won’t panic-sell ETH just because the testnet name disappears, and I won’t package the cleaning of the client’s old configuration into a new round of institutional buy pressure. What’s worth watching in this cycle is the boundary of development and staking test operations—price needs separate evidence.

The first fact: Geth v1.17.6 released on September 23 explicitly removes the Holesky testnet with an ended lifecycle. The corresponding code changes were merged on August 27 and involve the old network bootstrapping presets and built-in configuration. This is not an overnight announcement to shut down the Ethereum mainnet, and it’s not asking holders to move real ETH. Sources you can verify: github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/releases, and PR35591 in that repository.

Now put the timeline back where it belongs: The Ethereum Foundation published Holesky decommissioning notes as early as September 1, 2025. At that time, the migration split was that validators and staking infrastructure use Hoodi, while application development uses Sepolia. What I’m citing here is historical context—not treating last year’s decommissioning notice as a brand-new event today. The new observation is that the removal of the old environment has been concretely implemented in recent client versions. The Foundation’s original wording is: blog.ethereum.org/2025/09/01/holesky-shutdown-announcement.

Why is it still relevant to the market? My judgment is that staking service providers and application teams rely on the correct test environment. Also, the scripts still point to old presets, which could affect upgrade checks, node connectivity, or test results. Test failures don’t equal lost mainnet funds, but incorrect processes increase uncertainty around go-live. For ordinary holders, the more practical discipline is: don’t mix testnet coins with real ETH. Any unsolicited message saying “pay mainnet ETH to exchange for decommissioned test coins” should not be trusted based only on screenshots. Network migration also doesn’t automatically grant test assets real value.

How has the market reacted? As of 03:24 Beijing time on September 29, Binance’s ETHUSDT is around 2682.70, with the rolling 24-hour range at 2635.69 to 2721.42. Price is still within the range; I don’t have enough evidence to attribute this fluctuation to the Holesky removal. Client maintenance doesn’t directly equal new ETF net inflows—proof from fund subscriptions/redemptions and price action must be considered separately. You can check the market on Binance’s public spot interface, and USDT quotes are not the same as USD trade prices on every platform.

If I were trading myself: I wouldn’t participate. Assume a zero position—no shorting, no leverage. I’d only consider conditional spot longs: if the hour closes above 2700, then after a pullback holds 2695 to 2700, and trading plus deposits/withdrawals are normal, I’d enter with at most 0.3% of total funds. Reduce by half at 2712, then close the rest at 2722. If 2680 triggers a hard stop-loss, close everything; or if two consecutive hours close below 2695, exit all with no averaging down. If it breaks below 2635 before triggering, cancel this long plan.

The conditions that would overturn my view must also be clear: if the 2700 breakout fails, the support(s) above are lost, or an official confirmation emerges of a mainnet security issue or a problem with the funding channels, I’ll withdraw the participation conditions. Cleaning old test environments can’t replace security audits, and it definitely can’t be used as price insurance. This is only a plan pending verification—I’m not treating untriggered conditions as real executions or profits.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度很明确：不因为测试网名字消失就恐慌卖出ETH，也不把客户端清理旧配置包装成新一轮机构买盘。这轮值得看的是开发与质押测试的操作边界，价格需要另外给证据。

一手事实是，Geth九月23日发布的v1.17.6说明明确移除已结束生命周期的Holesky测试网。对应代码变更已在八月27日合并，涉及旧网络启动预设和内置配置。这不是今晚突然宣布关闭以太坊主网，更不是要求持有人转移真实ETH。来源可核对：github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/releases，以及该仓库的PR35591。

再把时间放回正确位置：以太坊基金会在2025年九月一日就发布过Holesky退役说明，彼时给出的迁移分工是验证者和质押基础设施使用Hoodi，应用开发使用Sepolia。这里引用的是历史背景，不把去年的退役通知当成今天的新事件。现在的新增观察，是近期正式客户端版本落实移除旧环境。基金会原文：blog.ethereum.org/2025/09/01/holesky-shutdown-announcement。

它为什么仍与市场有关？我的判断是，质押服务商和应用团队依赖正确的测试环境；脚本还指向旧预设，可能影响升级检查、连接节点或测试结果。测试失败不等于主网资金丢失，但错误流程会增加上线的不确定性。对普通持币人，更实用的纪律是别把测试币与真实ETH混在一起，任何“支付主网ETH兑换退役测试币”的私信都不应仅凭截图相信。网络迁移也不自动赋予测试资产真实价值。

市场已经怎样反应？北京时间九月29日03:24，币安ETHUSDT约2682.70，滚动24小时区间2635.69至2721.42。价格仍在区间内；我没有足够证据把这段波动归因于Holesky移除。客户端维护并不直接等于新增ETF净流入，基金申赎和币价的证据必须分开。行情可核对币安公开现货接口，USDT报价也不是所有平台的美元成交价。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，假设仓位为零，不做空、不加杠杆。只考虑条件式现货试多：小时收盘站上2700，随后回踩2695至2700守住，且成交、充值提现正常，才用总资金最多0.3%入场。2712先减一半，2722平掉剩余；2680触发硬止损全平，或连续两小时收在2695下方同样全部退出，不摊平。触发前跌破2635，取消这套多头计划。

推翻判断的条件也要明确：2700突破失败、上述支撑失守，或出现官方确认的主网安全与资金通道问题，我就撤回参与条件。旧测试环境清理不能替代安全审计，更不能替价格兜底。这只是待验证计划，没有把未触发条件写成真实成交或盈利。

📰 Why did Russia choose this moment to officially register a crypto exchange? What do the 30/60-day review periods mean?

Starting October 5, the Russian government officially began accepting registration applications from crypto exchanges and digital custodians. Banks need 30 business days to decide on an exchange’s application, and 60 days to process a digital custodian’s application. This timing coincides with a dip in major global cryptocurrencies (BTC $83,873.29 -0.98%, ETH $2,691.23 -0.18%) and an unsettled list of retail trading coins, suggesting a gradual regulatory approach.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is that Russia wants to bring the crypto industry out of the gray area and into a regulatory framework. This is not a countermeasure, but rather groundwork for potential future compliance pathways (such as STO). Choosing a market low could also be intended to reduce companies’ compliance costs. Compared with the EU’s crypto regulatory acceleration following Tesla’s incident earlier this year in May, Russia appears to be demonstrating an independent regulatory route—avoiding blindly following Western timelines.

Impact on the market
In the short term, Russia’s move will force global exchanges to make a choice: continue operating existing offshore venues, or move to a more compliant Russian market? This window of decision may prompt some exchanges to reassess geopolitical risk. But the long-term impact depends on whether Russia can deliver on its digital finance plans (such as the CBDC) and whether it can attract enough international projects to set up there. There is limited historical reference for similar events, but after Turkey’s crypto regulatory reforms in 2023, the local market size reportedly expanded 10-fold, which could serve as a reference.

💡 Neutral take: For now, Russia’s registration system looks more like a tool for regulatory formalization, with limited near-term impact on BTC/ETH trends. But a potential opportunity is that if Russian-registered exchanges gain high acceptance, they could encourage some capital flows toward crypto infrastructure. If the review standards are overly strict or the process drags on beyond two months, this expectation may not materialize. Holding above $2,700: watch Russia’s subsequent rollout; if it breaks below that level, take a bearish view on the broader crypto regulation trend.

title: 📈 Bitcoin & Altcoins: The Market Is Moving Again
subTitle:
Crypto has always moved in waves — and the latest one is a good reminder that Bitcoin rarely moves alone.
Bitcoin recently pushed above $86,000, marking an 8-month high after a strong recovery from its earlier 2026 weakness. Reports linked the move to stronger spot ETF flows, improving market sentiment and short covering.
But the interesting part is what happened across the rest of the market.
🔹 Ethereum (ETH) has also recovered strongly. After a major rally in late August, ETH entered consolidation before breaking above a key technical resistance level in September.
🔹 Solana (SOL) has recently traded above every price seen during the previous 90 days, showing that investors are again looking beyond Bitcoin.
🔹 XRP has had one of the more noticeable recent rebounds, gaining roughly 46% over three months, although it remains below its level from the beginning of 2026.
And this is where crypto becomes interesting.
Earlier in 2026, the market was much weaker and more selective. Research from Pantera Capital noted that Bitcoin finished 2025 down around 6%, Ethereum around 11%, while Solana fell roughly 34% and the broader token market excluding BTC, ETH and SOL dropped close to 60%.
Now we're seeing a different picture: Bitcoin is recovering, major altcoins are catching attention, and market participation is broadening.
But remember: a rising market doesn't mean every coin will rise together.
Crypto often rotates — Bitcoin moves first, then Ethereum and larger altcoins, followed by smaller and more speculative tokens. That is why looking at trend + volume + market structure, rather than simply chasing the biggest green candle, matters.
📊 The real question isn't “Which coin will pump next?”
It's:
Which coins are showing strength, which are recovering, and which are simply being carried by the market?
DYOR. Crypto remains highly volatile, and past performance is not a guarantee of future results.

📰 Why is it a new game for Bybit to use Franklin Templeton funds as collateral?

Bybit allows institutions to pledge shares of the Benji Fund under Franklin Templeton in exchange for fiat credit facilities, while the fund itself remains held in custody off-exchange. This means institutions can use crypto assets more flexibly without having to sell them immediately to get cash, while also reducing the risk of assets becoming unlinked.

Why is this news important?
At the core, this addresses the conflict between the “liquidity” and “ownership” of crypto assets. Traditional finance uses collateral-based lending, but in the crypto market, using collateral stablecoins or selling coins directly has downsides: the former has high capital costs, while the latter makes asset value vulnerable. Bybit’s move—letting institutions use off-exchange custodial shares as collateral—essentially opens a small window for the “securitization of assets” in crypto, which is especially beneficial for large asset managers like Franklin Templeton. In plain terms, it’s a solution that lets institutions obtain cash without being forced to liquidate their crypto holdings.

What does it mean for the market? 
It means the way crypto assets are allocated is becoming more diversified. Previously, institutions either traded on-exchange or held off-exchange. Now there’s a third option: getting liquidity through asset collateral. This is particularly important in a tightening regulatory environment, where institutions need funding tools that are both more compliant and more flexible.

Market impact
In the short term, sentiment is likely positive for BTC/ETH and helps improve the crypto market’s infrastructure. In the long term, if this kind of model expands to more asset management firms, it could lower the entry barrier for institutions and encourage more traditional capital to flow in. There aren’t many historical references to similar events, but it can be viewed as the first large-scale attempt to apply traditional collateral financing models in the crypto world.

Trading idea
💡 This news is overall neutral-to-positive for infrastructure. However, if regulators suddenly tighten off-exchange custody, this model could immediately come to a halt. Personally, I think in the short term BTC can hold the $82K level as a key prior support. If it breaks below this price, it would imply a marginal shift in institutions’ confidence in crypto assets, and the previous bullish logic would be invalidated.

📰 为什么 Bybit 用 Franklin Templeton 基金作抵押是场新游戏？

Bybit 允许机构用 Franklin Templeton 旗下的 Benji 基金份额做质押，换取法币信用额度，但基金本身还是留在场外托管。这意味着机构能更灵活地利用加密资产，不用立刻卖掉就能拿到钱，同时降低资产脱钩风险。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的核心是解决了加密资产「流动性」和「所有权」的矛盾。传统金融用抵押品融资，但加密市场抵押稳定币或直接卖币都有弊端——前者资金成本高，后者资产价值易受损。Bybit 这次让机构用场外托管份额做抵押，本质是给加密的「资产证券化」开了一扇小窗，尤其利好 Franklin Templeton 这种大型资管。说白了，这是让机构不用被迫抛售加密资产就能拿到现金的解决方案。

对市场意味着什么？意味着加密资产的配置方式开始多元化。以前机构要么场内交易，要么场外持有，现在有了第三种选择——用资产抵押获得流动性。这在监管趋严背景下尤其重要，机构需要更合规、更灵活的资金管理工具。

对市场的影响
对 BTC/ETH 价格短期看情绪利好，利好加密市场基础设施的完善。长期看，如果这类模式能扩大到更多资管机构，会降低机构入场门槛，促进更多传统资金流入。历史类似事件参考不多，但可以看作是传统金融抵押模式在加密世界的第一次大规模应用尝试。

操作思路
💡 这条新闻整体偏中性偏利好基础设施，但如果监管突然收紧场外托管，这个模式会立刻停摆。我个人认为，短期内 BTC 能守住 $82K 这个前期关键支撑位，如果跌破这个价位，意味着机构对加密资产信心的边际变化，之前看多逻辑作废。

🤔 Why can Bitcoin rebound quickly after dropping below $85,000? Where is the support level?

Bitcoin saw its worst day of the week. The price briefly fell below the $85,000 threshold, but then rebounded and is now hovering around $84,000. Although the daily candle closed down 0.66%, the monthly gain is still over 7%. Is this week-level pullback a normal adjustment as the market digests recent positives (such as continued ETF inflows), or does it signal weakening upward momentum?

Why is this news important?
This pullback isn’t without reason. After setting a new yearly high last week, Bitcoin accumulated pressure from profit-taking. $85,000 is not only a crucial technical level—it also happens to coincide with stop-loss levels for some long positions. And its ability to rebound quickly suggests strong support below—possibly a cushion formed by technical moving averages, or perhaps risk-averse capital quietly stepping in during the dip. Deeper down, this reflects a tug-of-war between optimistic sentiment and real fundamentals: while ongoing ETF inflows bring incremental capital, that added liquidity hasn’t fully transformed into sustained upside momentum yet.

Impact on the market
In the short term, if Bitcoin holds above $84,000, the pullback may only be temporary consolidation, and the uptrend remains intact. If it can stabilize near the prior week’s low around $83,000—and even break above $85,000 with increased volume—bullish momentum could regroup. Conversely, if it falls below $83,000, the month’s 7% gain may face a significant risk of retracement. The impact on other coins such as ETH may be relatively lagged, but overall market sentiment fluctuations can still spill over.

Trading approach
I believe this Bitcoin pullback is more like a technical correction rather than a trend reversal. If it manages to hold the $83,000 line of defense, I lean bullish, with the first target around $86,000. But if it breaks below that level, this view would be invalid.

比特币经历了周内最差的一天，价格一度跌破8.5万美元关口，但随后出现反弹，目前稳在8.4万美元附近。尽管日线收跌0.66%，但月度涨幅依然超过7%。这场周内级别的回调，是在市场消化近期利好（如ETF持续流入）后的正常调整，还是预示着上涨动能减弱？

为什么这条新闻重要？
比特币这次回调并非空穴来风。上周它创出年内新高后，积聚了获利了结压力。8.5万美元不仅是技术关键位，也恰好触及到部分做多的止损线。而它能迅速反弹，说明下方支撑强劲——可能是技术均线形成的缓冲垫，也可能是避险资金在回调时悄悄接盘。更深层看，这反映了市场在乐观情绪与现实基本面之间的拉锯，ETF持续流入带来的增量资金尚未完全转化为持续上涨动力。

对市场的影响
短期看，比特币守住8.4万美元意味着回调可能只是短暂的整理，上升趋势依然完好。如果能在8.3万美元这个上周低点附近企稳，甚至进一步放量突破8.5万美元，则多头动能可能重新积聚。反之，如果跌破8.3万美元，那么这个月7%的涨幅可能面临较大回吐风险。对ETH等其他币种的影响相对滞后，但整体市场的情绪波动会传导。

操作思路
我认为比特币这次回调更像是一次技术性修正，而非趋势逆转。如果它能稳住8.3万美元防线，我倾向于看涨，第一目标看向8.6万美元。但如果跌破这个位置，这个判断就作废。

📰 Why the US diesel ban could weigh on global oil prices? A full breakdown of the risks warned by Devere Group Nigel Green

The United States may impose a ban on diesel exports, which would raise overseas fuel costs and ultimately push up US gasoline prices. Devere Group CEO Nigel Green issued the warning on September 28. When the news broke, international oil prices were already rising due to President Trump rejecting Iran’s proposal regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

A ban could increase global transportation and production costs, with impacts that extend beyond the US mainland.

Why is this news important?

The US is one of the world’s largest diesel producers, so a diesel export ban would directly affect global supply chains. Diesel is the lifeblood of industrial production and transportation. A ban would mean that major global economies could face upward cost pressures. This isn’t just a simple trade friction—it’s a systemic risk to the energy supply chain.

Why? Because the US doesn’t only export diesel; it also exports global energy pricing power. That means that if the US voluntarily limits supply, global oil prices could be forced down—like a brake being pressed—but the direction may still be uncertain.

This ties in with the recent US Federal Reserve rate hikes and rising geopolitical tensions, which have left markets highly sensitive to potential supply-chain disruptions. What does that mean? In the short term, energy stocks, airlines, and logistics companies that rely on diesel transport may face pressure.

Market impact

What does it mean for BTC/ETH prices?

Although this isn’t directly crypto-related news, a rise in oil prices could indirectly affect market sentiment. Higher energy costs → lower corporate profits → reduced appeal of risk assets → crypto could face pressure. But recently, BTC has been consolidating around $83,599 and ETH has been moving sideways around $2,684, suggesting strong defensive positioning.

For the market structure, if the ban becomes reality, regulators may pay more attention to whether volatility in the energy market is transmitted to the crypto market. In terms of capital flows, safe-haven funds may accelerate inflows into traditional safe-haven assets like US Treasuries.

Historically, similar events—such as the 1973 oil embargo—led to a global economic recession and a spike in market volatility. If something similar happens this time, it will be important to watch whether comparable effects emerge.

💡 I’m neutral to bearish. The main risk is that warming inflation expectations could force the Federal Reserve to hike rates further, pressuring risk assets. The key level to watch is BTC at $82,000. If it breaks below this line, the logic no longer holds. If the Fed chooses to cut rates or keep rates unchanged, this view would be invalid.

📰 美国柴油禁令为何让全球油价承压？Devere Group Nigel Green警告的风险全解析

美国可能对柴油出口实施禁令，这会导致海外燃油成本上升，并最终推高美国汽油价格。Devere Group CEO Nigel Green在9月28日发出警告。这一消息传出时，国际油价正因特朗普拒绝伊朗霍尔木兹海峡提议而上涨。禁令可能增加全球运输和生产成本，影响范围不止美国本土。

为什么这条新闻重要？
美国是全球最大的柴油生产国之一，柴油出口禁令直接影响全球供应链。柴油是工业生产和交通运输的血液，禁令意味着全球主要经济体可能面临成本上升压力。这不是简单的贸易摩擦，而是能源供应链的系统性风险。为什么？因为美国不仅输出柴油，还输出全球能源定价权。这意味着，如果美国主动限制供应，全球油价会像被踩了刹车，但方向还不确定。这与近期美联储加息、地缘政治紧张叠加，市场对供应链中断的敏感度已处于高位有关。意味着什么？短期内，能源股、航空公司和依赖柴油运输的物流公司可能承压。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH价格有什么影响？虽然不是直接的加密货币新闻，但油价上涨会间接影响市场情绪。能源成本上升→企业利润下滑→风险资产吸引力下降→加密货币可能承压。但近期BTC在$83,599附近盘整，ETH在$2,684附近横盘，显示出较强的防御性。对市场格局而言，如果禁令落地，监管机构可能会更关注能源市场的波动是否传导至加密市场。对资金流向，避险资金可能加速流入美国国债等传统避险资产。历史上类似事件，如1973年的石油禁运，曾导致全球经济衰退，市场波动率飙升。这次如果发生，需要关注是否会出现类似效应。

💡 我看中性偏空，主要风险在于通胀预期升温可能迫使美联储进一步加息，打压风险资产。值得关注的价位是BTC $82,000，如果跌破这条线，逻辑就不成立了。如果美联储选择降息或维持利率不变，这个判断作废。

📰 Why is Arc borrowing $150 million USDC backed by cirBTC? Does this mean a new way of Bitcoin lending is coming?

Arc is a DeFi platform, and recently it made a big move: it let institutions use Bitcoin derivatives, cirBTC (Circle’s Bitcoin certificate), as collateral to borrow $150 million worth of USDC. This is particularly notable because, before this, when institutions wanted to borrow against Bitcoin, they either had to sell the BTC—no matter whether it was an issue—or they could only use BTC itself as collateral. Now they don’t need actual BTC; cirBTC is enough. In effect, it adds a “leverage layer” to Bitcoin. This is a major positive for institutions that want Bitcoin liquidity but don’t want to sell their BTC.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is that institutional demand for BTC is rising, but they don’t want to sell this “hard currency.” Why? Simply put: BTC is too expensive—buying it directly is costly. Meanwhile, cirBTC is a derivative and is much cheaper than real BTC, but it still tracks the BTC price. That allows institutions to meet the conflicting needs of wanting BTC liquidity without taking on price downside risk. Behind this is the market’s recognition of the “financial nature” of digital assets—meaning they can obtain capital without selling the asset. Recently, regulators have become more tolerant of derivatives policies, which has also accelerated this trend.

Market impact
The impact on BTC/ETH prices may be short-term sentiment volatility, but in the long run, this model increases the supply of BTC liquidity. Previously, institutions needed to sell BTC to get cash; now they have an alternative. This implies that the effective real supply of BTC may decrease slightly, which could support prices. A similar historical reference: earlier, Leverage.finance used stablecoins as collateral to lend against ETH, which led to a sudden 30% increase in ETH liquidity and a short-term price rise. However, keep in mind that derivative-backed borrowing also carries default risk. If the price of cirBTC crashes, institutions may need to use real BTC to top up collateral—ironically increasing pressure on the BTC market. As of now, BTC is holding steady around $83K. If this model proves effective, prices could strengthen again after a short-term pullback.

Trading idea
I believe this kind of derivative-collateralized model will become increasingly popular, especially among institutional investors. If BTC can hold the existing $80K support level, this approach will accelerate the financialization process of BTC. But if regulation suddenly tightens how cirBTC is recognized, or if large-scale default events occur, this logic falls apart.

If BTC breaks below the key psychological level of $78K, this assessment becomes invalid.

📰 为什么 Arc 要借 1.5 亿 USDC 担保 cirBTC？意味着比特币借贷新玩法要来了吗？

Arc 是个做 DeFi 的平台，最近搞了个大事：让机构用比特币衍生品 cirBTC（Circle 的比特币凭证）做抵押，借了 1.5 亿美元 USDC。这事儿很特别，因为以前机构借比特币，要么卖掉 BTC 要不要紧，要么只能用 BTC 本身抵押。现在他们不用真 BTC，只要 cirBTC 就行，等于给 BTC 加了一层"杠杆层"。这对想拿 BTC 流动性但又不想卖 BTC 的机构来说，是重大利好。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的根本原因在于机构对 BTC 的需求在涨，但又不想卖掉这个"硬通货"。为啥？简单说，BTC 太贵了，直接买成本太高。而 cirBTC 是个衍生品，比真 BTC 便宜很多，但本质还是盯 BTC 价格，能满足机构想拿 BTC 流动性又不想亏价格的矛盾需求。这背后是市场对数字资产"金融属性"的认可——即不用卖资产，也能获得资金。最近监管政策对衍生品的容忍度提高，也加速了这个趋势。

对市场的影响
对 BTC/ETH 价格的影响可能是短期的情绪波动，但中长期看，这种模式会提高 BTC 的流动性供给。以前机构需要卖 BTC 才能获得现金，现在他们有了替代方案。这意味着 BTC 的实际供给量会减少一点点，对价格有支撑作用。历史类似事件参考：之前 Leverage.finance 用稳定币抵押 ETH 借贷，导致 ETH 流动性突然增加 30%，价格短期跟涨。但要注意，衍生品借贷也存在违约风险，一旦 cirBTC 价格暴跌，机构可能需要用真 BTC 补仓，反而增加 BTC 市场压力。目前看，BTC 在 $83K 附近表现坚挺，如果这个模式被证明有效，价格可能会在短期回调后继续走强。

操作思路
我认为这种用衍生品抵押的模式会越来越流行，特别是对机构投资者。如果 BTC 能守住 $80K 现有支撑位，这个模式会加速 BTC 的金融化进程。但如果监管突然收紧对 cirBTC 的认定，或者出现大规模违约事件，这个逻辑就作废了。

如果 BTC 跌破 $78K 这个关键心理价位，这个判断作废。

title: 以太坊何时能破 5000？
subTitle:
2686 美元。

这是 ETH 此刻的价格。距离 5000 美元，还差 86%。

最近社群里看多 ETH 的声音明显多了起来：ETF 连续两周净流入破 10 亿美金、Glamsterdam 升级要把 Gas Limit 翻三倍多、CLARITY Act 监管落地、质押被明确不构成证券……利好一个接一个。但我拉完合约数据却发现一个诡异的信号：币安 U 本位合约上，全网做多 ETH 的账户占比已经到了 72.6%。

翻译成人话：4 个开合约的人里有 3 个在做多。

这到底是共识，还是拥挤交易？ETH 到底能不能摸到 5000？我把多空两边的账都算给你看。

一、先看现实位置

ETH 现在 2686，24 小时基本平盘，成交 88 亿美金。资金费率 0.0061%，贴着 0，说明杠杆并不拥挤。持仓量稳定在 230 万 ETH，约 60 亿美金，过去 24 小时没有大变化。

从周期位置看，ETH 从 7 月低点反弹到现在已经走了两个月。但 ETH/BTC 汇率一直在 0.03 附近横盘，没有走出独立行情——这意味着 ETH 目前还是跟着 BTC 大盘走，自己的叙事还没完全独立。

二、多头手里的牌

看多的逻辑确实硬：

第一，ETF 资金在持续流入。9 月第一周美国现货 ETH ETF 净流入 2.18 亿美金，过去两周累计突破 10 亿。BlackRock 和 Fidelity 这种传统巨头的渠道能力，是 2021 年那轮没有的——那时候只能靠散户在交易所买，现在是 401k 和家族办公室在配置。

第二，Glamsterdam 升级。这次升级要把 Gas Limit 从 60M 提到 200M，配合并行执行，目标 TPS 从现在的 15–30 直接干到 10000。同时引入 ePBS（提议者-构建者分离），把区块构建去中心化。如果落地，ETH 从"昂贵的全球结算层"变成"真能跑应用的链"，叙事会完全变。

第三，通缩叙事。上海升级后已经销毁了 1250 万 ETH，净通胀率压得很低。ETF 持续买 + 质押锁仓 + 销毁，流通盘在收缩。

第四，监管落地。CLARITY Act 推进，质押被明确不构成证券，SEC 那边的法律不确定性在下降。

三、空头手里的牌

但冷水也得泼：

第一，宏观。跟 BTC 一样，美联储 9 月刚加息 25bp 到 3.75–4%，点阵图暗示年内还要加。ETH 作为风险资产，估值靠的是未来现金流折现，利率越高，折现率越高，估值越受压。

第二，多头太拥挤。72.6% 的账户在做多，这个数字在历史上是反向指标。一旦有风吹草动，多杀多的踩踏会非常猛。资金费率现在虽然低，但那是因为大家在现货/ETF 里买，合约上还没堆杠杆——一旦散户开始加杠杆追多，资金费率飙升就是顶部信号。

第三，ETH/BTC 汇率没起来。如果 ETH 真要走独立牛市，应该看到 ETH/BTC 从 0.03 拉到 0.05 以上。现在还在横盘，说明机构只是把 ETH 当 BTC 的影子配置，没有独立买盘。

第四，L2 分流。Base、Arbitrum、Optimism 拿走了大部分应用层活跃度，L1 的 Gas 费根本涨不起来，"通缩"叙事在低 Gas 环境下其实通缩不起来。

四、5000 美元需要什么条件？

从 2686 到 5000，需要涨 86%。我列一下必须同时满足的条件：

1. BTC 得先站稳 9 万并创新高。ETH 不可能在 BTC 横盘时自己翻倍，大盘不给 β，α 做不出来。
2. ETF 连续 4–6 周保持每周 5 亿美金以上净流入，而不是现在的每周 1–2 亿。
3. Glamsterdam 升级按计划落地且没有大事故。
4. 美联储 10 月 27 号加息落地后，市场开始定价 2027 年降息。
5. 多头账户占比从 73% 降回 55% 以下——意味着中间要有一次像样的洗盘，把不坚定的多单洗出去。

这五条里只要有两条不满足，5000 就是画饼。

五、我的判断

短期（1–3 个月）：ETH 大概率在 2400–3000 区间震荡。73% 的多头拥挤度需要时间消化，要么用时间磨，要么用一根大阴线洗。直接拉到 5000 我不信。

中期（6–12 个月）：如果 Glamsterdam 顺利落地 + ETF 持续流入 + 美联储转向降息，5000 可以摸到，但不是现在。

长期：ETH 的叙事比 BTC 更依赖应用落地，如果 TPS 真的从 30 干到 10000，它就从"数字商品"变成"世界计算机"，估值逻辑会重写。

最后一句：

别在 73% 都看多的时候冲进去。真正的大机会，是等那次洗盘把多头占比打到 50% 以下、价格回到 2200–2400 区间的时候——那时候你再看这些利好，才是真便宜。

你觉得 ETH 年底能到多少？评论区聊聊。

Solana 此次营收回升并非偶然，而是其在经历了一波大规模裁员和流动性危机后，主动剥离非核心业务、聚焦核心 DeFi 及 NFT 生态的结果。这背后是 Solana 用真金白银验证其技术路线的可行性——如果低交易费和快速确认能真正转化为商业价值，那其他链的技术优势将不再仅是纸面实力。这和当前加密市场普遍的降本增效趋势一致，意味着 Web3 从概念炒作转向务实盈利的关键转折点或许已经到来。

As short-term U.S. Treasury yields rise, the market tightens up first by one notch.

Citing an analysis by Jonathan Levin, a columnist for Bloomberg, BlockBeats says that as the Federal Reserve restarts rate hikes, the U.S. Treasury market is shifting from concerns about fiscal deficits and long-term debt supply to expectations that rates will be kept high for longer. Since Fed Chair Powell’s hawkish remarks at Jackson Hole in late August, the real yields on 2-year and 5-year Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) have risen by roughly 57 and 64 basis points, respectively.

Since September, the yield on U.S. 2-year Treasuries has climbed cumulatively by about 55 basis points. Meanwhile, the spread between the 10-year and 2-year yields narrowed at one point to around 17 basis points—the lowest level since early 2025. The market currently assigns roughly a two-thirds probability that the Fed will hike again in October, and has priced in an increase over the coming year of at least the equivalent of three 25-basis-point hikes.

On one side: yields continue to push higher and the dollar stays relatively strong. On the other: risk assets like BTC and ETH are more sensitive to interest-rate changes. If the 2-year yield keeps surging higher but BTC doesn’t break a key support level, it suggests there’s still demand/absorption in the market. But if rates step up further while risk appetite retreats in tandem, the downside pressure will be more direct. Which do you care more about—2-year U.S. Treasuries or the dollar?

以太坊市场深度分析：协议升级预期与短期抛压的拉锯战

一、价格走势回顾

北京时间九月二十八日下午，以太坊现货报价两千六百八十点三九美元，过去二十四小时内呈现窄幅震荡格局。从小时级别K线观察，价格在亚洲时段一度上探至两千六百九十八点六八美元的高点，随后在欧美时段回落，最低触及两千六百五十一点六八美元，最终在两千六百六十美元一线企稳整理。整体波动幅度相对有限，显示市场处于方向选择的关键节点。

从资金面来看，美国现货以太坊ETF上周录得六亿八千九百八十八万美元的净流入，机构资金的持续配置为以太坊提供了有力的底部支撑。与此同时，BitMine公司新增购入一万七千三百六十二枚以太坊，总持仓已超过六百万枚，占流通供应量的百分之四点九，企业级买盘的力度不容忽视。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线位于两千六百六十九点零七美元，二十五小时均线位于两千六百七十点六九美元，九十九小时均线位于两千六百八十六点一八美元。短期均线与中期均线高度粘合，价格围绕均线群反复穿越，表明市场处于典型的盘整蓄势阶段。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于两千六百九十七点零六美元，中轨位于两千六百六十五点五零美元，下轨位于两千六百三十三点九三美元。当前价格运行在中轨上方，接近上轨区域，带宽持续收窄，暗示即将迎来方向性突破。

MACD指标方面，DIF线位于负四点一五，DEA线位于负七点三零，柱状线为正值三点一六。MACD虽仍在零轴下方运行，但柱状线已连续多个周期保持正值并呈扩大趋势，显示多头力量正在逐步积聚。RSI指标读数约为四十九，处于中性区域，既未进入超买也未进入超卖，为后续的方向选择留出了充足空间。

KDJ指标中K线位于六十一，D线位于六十点六，J线位于六十一八点九，三线在中位区域粘合，短期方向尚不明朗。威廉指标读数约为负四十九点三，同样处于中性区间。综合各项技术指标来看，以太坊正处于震荡蓄势的末期，一旦突破当前区间，可能迎来较大幅度的单边行情。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多重因素的交织影响。利好方面，以太坊联合创始人维塔利克布特林近日表示，计划中的Hegotá升级可能是以太坊最后一次传统意义上的硬分叉，此后开发重心将转向递归STARK证明、量子安全密码学以及混合链上链下的密码学世界计算机架构。这一前瞻性路线图极大增强了社区对以太坊长期技术演进的信心，分析师据此给出八千六百美元的长期目标价，前提是价格能够突破五千美元的关键阻力位。

此外，七只经过Coinbase代币化的美国科技股，包括苹果、英伟达、特斯拉、亚马逊和Meta，已在Base链上的Aave V4协议中上线为抵押品，用户可以用这些现实世界资产借出USDC。这一里程碑事件标志着传统金融与去中心化金融的深度融合正在加速，为以太坊生态带来了实质性的应用场景拓展。

CCIP Second-Gen Heat Rising｜Faster Arrival Doesn’t Mean Ethereum Is Final｜ETH near $2,665; I’ll wait

I’m optimistic about the exploration of payment efficiency, but I won’t treat a “seconds to complete” claim as a direct buy-the-dip signal to chase ETH. Tonight, the topic #ChainlinkLaunchesCCIP2WithEnterpriseVerification is gaining traction in the Plaza. What I care about most is the speed and risk configuration—not packaging enterprise verification as proof that all cross-chain transactions are already safely settled in seconds.

On September 28, Chainlink’s official release introduced CCIP second-gen. By default, it still waits for full final confirmation of the source chain. The issuer can set faster confirmation thresholds for specific use cases. The article also uses “when it launches” phrasing when discussing support for Ethereum fast confirmation rules (FCR). So, the protocol update has already been published, and the Ethereum-related rules are fully enabled—that’s two different things. You can’t drop the time condition and write future capabilities as if they’re already facts on the mainnet today.

When reading the cross-reading developer documentation, configurations lower than the default final confirmation increase the risk of source-chain reorganizations. Under certain conditions, the destination chain may already execute, while the source transaction later gets replaced. The documentation warns about possible duplicate execution or insufficiently supported tokens, and requires applications to evaluate and correct their logic. Ethereum’s official consensus materials also distinguish block inclusion from finality; finality involves checking checkpoints and voting on staked weights. My judgment: small, high-frequency payments and large settlement deliveries shouldn’t share the same speed promise. Users need to know what risks they’re accepting—not just stare at a settlement “countdown animation.”

How does this affect the crypto market? Under controllable risk, shortening the time funds are waiting could improve cross-chain payments and asset turnover. But efficiency improvements don’t automatically mean an immediate net increase in spot ETH buying. You still need to look at real paid usage, fee attribution, and long-term retention. And you can’t count the same asset moving across networks as two new inflows of fresh capital. Even if others enable the fast mode, it doesn’t automatically change your own finality configuration.

Market reaction should first be judged by verifiable data. At the time of writing, Kraken’s ETH/USD is about $2,665.42. Over the past 24 hours, the range was $2,635.57 to $2,702.45. The price is still within the range; this single announcement doesn’t prove a trend reversal. I have no evidence to attribute this volatility to CCIP. Rising “heat” means more discussion—but it doesn’t mean institutions have already bought coins. $2,675 is my entry observation threshold; around $2,700 I watch for overhead resistance; if it falls below around $2,635, I cancel the plan first. These are conditional levels, not predictions that must come true.

If this were my own trading: my participation ratio in this plan is 0%. I won’t short or add leverage. I’d consider at most a 0.3% total-funds spot long only if the price closes above $2,675 for one hour, then retests $2,670 to $2,675 and holds, with quotes and deposits/withdrawals functioning normally. Then at $2,690 I’d halve, and at $2,700 I’d close the remaining position. After entry, I’d place a hard stop-loss at $2,655. Or, if after two hours it returns below $2,670, I’d close everything without averaging down. Before entering, I cancel the plan if it breaks below $2,635, if the official risk warning is upgraded, or if the actual settlement channel becomes abnormal. If later there are verifiable, sustained business needs and price confirmations, I’ll adjust my outlook. Otherwise, I won’t write anything as a “trade” and certainly not as a “profit.”

One more round of verification: Chainlink’s “Introducing CCIP 2.0” and the FTF developer documentation; ethereum.org’s consensus materials. The price is from the Kraken snapshot.
#ChainlinkLaunchesCCIP2WithEnterpriseVerification #ETH #LINK

CCIP二代热度上升｜快到账不等于以太坊最终确认｜ETH在2665美元附近我先等

我的态度是看好支付效率的探索，但不把“几秒完成”直接当成ETH追涨信号。今晚广场的#ChainlinkLaunchesCCIP2WithEnterpriseVerification话题升温，我更关心其中的速度与风险配置，而不是把企业验证包装成所有跨链交易都已经安全秒结算。

9月28日Chainlink官方发布CCIP二代介绍：默认配置仍等待来源链完整最终确认，发行方可针对特定用途设置更快的确认门槛。文章谈到支持以太坊快速确认规则FCR时，用的是“当它推出时”的条件表述。因此，协议更新已经发布，与以太坊相关规则已经全面启用，是两件不同的事；不能省略时间条件，把未来能力写成今天的主网事实。

交叉读开发文档，低于默认最终确认的配置会增加来源链重组风险；某些条件下，目标链可能已经执行，而来源交易后来被替换。文档提示可能出现重复执行或无足额支持的代币，并要求应用评估纠正逻辑。以太坊官方共识说明也区分区块被纳入与最终确认，后者涉及检查点和质押权重投票。我的判断：小额高频支付与大额交割不应套用同一速度承诺，用户需要知道自己接受了什么风险，而不是只看到账动画。

为什么影响加密市场？可控风险下缩短资金等待，可能改善跨链支付和资产周转；但效率改善不等于立刻增加ETH现货净买入。还要看真实付费使用、费用归属和长期留存，不能把同一次资产搬家算成两个网络的新资金。别人启用快速模式，也不等于自动改变了自己的最终确认配置。

Wallets and exchanges are verified separately｜Not being affected by this incident doesn’t mean there is comprehensive no risk｜ETH near $2,688—I’ll wait first

My attitude is: first clarify who controls your assets, then decide whether to trade. You can’t treat an exchange’s withdrawal-withdrawal arrangement as an emergency migration instruction for a self-custody wallet just because the product names sound similar. And you also can’t chase ETH just because you see a security statement.

The hot topics on the forum are mainly focused on gold, QNT, and Asian stock markets. ETH hasn’t entered the hot search list, so I won’t tag unrelated labels.

Bitget Wallet’s September 25 statement said that its preventive checks found no impact from this exchange incident on its system or on users’ self-custody assets at that time, and it explained that both parties’ system architecture, wallet infrastructure, and custody mechanisms are independent of each other. The exchange’s latest statement also confirmed that this non-custodial product was not affected by the incident. These are both parties’ official statements—not independent audit conclusions, and not a guarantee of all future risks.

So why does this affect ETH? The exchange’s ETH balances, withdrawal channels, and on-chain ETH in personal wallets are different issues of control and usability. If the market conflates them, it’s easy to misread a service plan on a single platform as “the entire Ethereum network is having problems,” or, in panic, to trust a fake support/customer service. My view is that clarifying custody boundaries can reduce operational mistakes, but it doesn’t in itself provide evidence of new incremental spot buying for ETH. Nor can you infer that all wallet plugins, interacting contracts, and personal operations are safe.

The wallet’s official team also reminds users not to connect third-party websites for so-called security verification, and not to move assets according to unfamiliar notifications. If you receive a suspicious link, stop and verify through official channels. For traders, protecting your operating permissions is more important than rushing to catch the next leg of a rebound.

As for ETH withdrawals from the exchange: they are still scheduled for September 29 at 08:00 UTC / 16:00 Beijing time. You can’t write it in advance as “already restored,” and you also can’t use the fact that the wallet service is functioning normally to guarantee that the exchange’s withdrawals will work.

On the price side, at 21:26 (Beijing time) on September 28, Kraken’s latest ETH/USD is around $2,687.52. Over the past 24 hours, the range has been $2,635.57 to $2,714.53. Price is in the upper-middle portion of the range and has not broken above the upper bound yet. I don’t have evidence of per-trade fund flows or an incident window, so I can’t attribute this rebound to the wallet statement. Watch for confirmation around 2,695, pressure near 2,710, and the risk line at 2,665.

If I were trading myself: I won’t participate. My planned position is zero—no shorting, no leverage. Only if the hour-close is above 2,695, then after a pullback holds the 2,690 to 2,695 area, and the platform quotes and deposits/withdrawals are normal, I’d consider at most a spot trial long position of 0.3% of total funds. The target is 2,710 to cut half, then 2,725 to close the rest. If it breaks below 2,665 with a hard stop-loss, or if two consecutive hourly closes are below 2,690, I’ll fully close. If it breaks below 2,640 before entry, the plan is cancelled. If later official reports change the scope of wallet impact, or if there are anomalous signatures or channel issues, I’ll cancel participation too. If it doesn’t trigger, it’s not a trade—no “profit recap.”

Sources: [Wallet statement](https://web3.bitget.com/zh-CN/blog/articles/self-custody-security-statement), [Exchange update](https://www.bitget.com/amp/academy/bitget-security-incident-what-happened-timeline-impact-response).
#ETH

广场热题集中在黄金、QNT和亚洲股市，ETH未进入热搜，不挂无关标签。Bitget Wallet九月二十五日声明称，预防性检查截至当时未发现本次交易所事件影响其系统或用户自托管资产，并说明双方的系统架构、钱包基础设施和托管机制相互独立。交易所最新说明也确认，这个非托管产品未受此次事件影响。这是双方官方表述，不是独立审计结论，更不是对以后所有风险的保证。

这为什么影响ETH？交易所内的ETH余额、提现通道和个人钱包内的链上ETH，是不同的控制与可用性问题。市场若混为一谈，容易把单个平台的服务安排误读成整个以太坊网络出问题，或者在恐慌中误信假客服。我的判断是，托管边界澄清能减少错误操作，但本身不构成ETH新增买盘的证据，也不能推导出所有钱包插件、交互合约和个人操作都安全。
